title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
statement: Simulate a trie of lowercase words. `operations` contains insert, search, and startsWith. `arguments[i]` is the word or prefix for that call. insert returns null. search returns whether the word was inserted. startsWith returns whether any inserted word has that prefix.
hints: Each node owns a map from character to child, plus a boolean that says a word ends here.
insert walks or creates a child for every character and marks the last node.
search requires the end mark. startsWith only requires that the walk succeeds.

approaches.name: Hash set of words plus a prefix scan

complexity.time: O(total length) worst case per prefix

approaches.explanation: Correct, and slow when many words share prefixes.

editorial: A trie is a deterministic automaton for the inserted strings. The end mark is separate from the existence of children, because a prefix of an inserted word is not itself inserted unless insert was called on it. startsWith stops at the last character of the prefix and ignores the end mark.

examples.explanation: app is a prefix before it is inserted, and a word afterward.
An empty trie rejects both queries.
